TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry

We Will see the same when creating the entry.
Supported documents are: PDF, Word, Excel, .md files

Project structure
DataAccess Logic
Acceses postgre database with entityframework that acceses the database.
We have a general class that is inherited by entity and allows performing the CRUD against the entities
It should have validations, Transactional save of multiple entities

Business Logic
Allows cross entity operations and transactional savings
AI and RAG operations Will be in this layer although they aren't defined now.

WebApi
Exposes the entities and information by entity to the UI with ODataQueries and Create, Delete and UpdateOperations

UI
A react application that has all the screens and requ

Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

Landing page
In the landing page we should have a left tool bar  with the different menus the user can Access.
That menú bar can be shown and hided with the hamburger button. So the screen can be used in mobile.
The User Profile should be on it's own page and be accesed from té toolbar
The Users sceeen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar
The Projects screen should be on it's own page and be accesed from the toolbar

The table UserRoles are the roles that are selectable for a user.
It should not have the UserId

sourceContexts.text:
Login Screen
The login screen should show only Login information and links to Access to Password Recovery
Password Recovery should have two steps:
Request password recovery to an email
And reset the password with the token sent
Both should be different urls and screens the user Will acces.
Both should not be showed on the login screen

Maintenance screens
The screen maintenance should work this way:
When you enter them a grid with existing data should be shown.
From the grid you can delete a record or navigate to one to update it
Also you can push a button to créate a new record.
Both editing and creating screens are different from the consult screen where the grid is shown.

This applies to projects, users, and timelines screens

Project structure
DataAccess Logic
Acceses postgre database with entityframework that acceses the database.
We have a general class that is inherited by entity and allows performing the CRUD against the entities
It should have validations, Transactional save of multiple entities

Business Logic
Allows cross entity operations and transactional savings
AI and RAG operations Will be in this layer although they aren't defined now.

WebApi
Exposes the entities and information by entity to the UI with ODataQueries and Create, Delete and UpdateOperations

UI
A react application that has all the screens and requirements to mantain the entities and interact with them.
Identified screens
Login
Password recovery
User maintenance
Project maintenance
Project TimeLine list
TimeLineWorkingScreen where add entries for an specific timeline.

Thechnology considerations
.NET 10
MicrosoftAgentFramework for AI operations with Harness
EntityFramework Core
Postgree database
React on UI

You must deploy the database with initial records. Everythin must run with dotnet run.
The app must run correctly.
Divide projects for
Database
DataAccessLogic
BusinessLogic
UI+WebApi

Landing page

It should not have the UserId
The User should have the IDUserRole field with a value selected from UserRole table.
In the existing record the user should have the role Admin

TimeLine Maintenance
When we enter a Project we Will see it's timeline as a conversation.
We should see the different entries of the timeline: By each entry we Will see the firs 500 characters of the entry of the timeline 
and a link to download the artifacts that generated that text if they are available.
We could click on it to navigate to a full entry screen where we Will see:
Full text of the entry
The user that created that entry
Links to download the artifacts(files) that created that entry
An option to add a new file to the entry
